text: Last weekend, Karen wanted to make a purchase, so she went shopping for new clothes. She had a small budget, so she wanted to find a good bargain. First, she went online to browse different shops and compare prices before leaving home. At the store, there was a big sale, so many items had a discount. Karen tried on a jacket, but it was too expensive, and she couldn't afford it. She found a cheaper one instead, in a smaller size. At the checkout, she paid with her credit card instead of cash. The customer service worker gave her a receipt and said that if the jacket didn't fit, she could bring it back for an exchange or a refund. Karen also bought some things online for home delivery, because it was more convenient than carrying heavy bags. A week later, she realized the jacket was the wrong size, so she returned it to the store with her receipt. The staff were friendly and gave her money back immediately. Karen was happy because she found some real bargains and stayed within her budget.
